input.final_summary: Combat UI is driven mainly by `combat_test.tscn` + `combat_test.gd` (layout shell) and `combat_root.gd` + `symbol_slot.gd` (grid FX and per-symbol win popups). content.text:
**Primary playtest shell:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn` + `combat_test.gd` (runtime reparenting/layout). **Grid/combat logic:** `combat_root.tscn` + `combat_root.gd`, instanced as `%CombatRoot`.

---

### Winnings text over matched middle symbol

- **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd`** — `_win_label` / node `WinPopupLabel`; `_ensure_win_label()`, `play_win_popup()`. Full-cell centered label (font 14, yellow, outline 2); fades in and drifts **up 8px** (`position:y` tween). Text is `"+{payout}"` from combat.
- **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`** — `_line_popup_anchor_coord()`, `_play_count_flash_for_lines()`, `_show_win_popups_for_lines()`. Picks the matched cell **closest to the line’s geometric center** (middle cell on typical lines), then calls `play_win_popup` on that slot.
- **`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/symbol.tscn`** — `SymbolSlot` + `Icon`; slot size comes from `fit_to_panel()` / `_apply_slot_min_size()` in `combat_root.gd` (popup is parented to the slot).

**Separate round readout (band under grid, not on a symbol):**

- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_build_play_shell()`: `WinningsCenter` → `WinningsRow` → `WinningsReadoutPill` → `%MultiplierReadout` (`mult_label`). `_configure_winnings_readout()`, `_refresh_readouts()` set text to round winnings (`"%d"`).
- **`combat_test.tscn`** — `MultiplierReadout` (scene default; reparented at runtime).
- **`combat_root.tscn`** — `RoundWinningsLabel` (legacy); **`combat_root.gd`** `_refresh_round_winnings_label()` keeps it **hidden** in this shell.

---

### Spin history log (rows / text)

- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_build_history_placeholder()` → `HistoryPanel` / `HistorySpinList`; `_append_history_spin_row()`, `_format_history_factor()`, `_clear_history_spin_list()`. Each win adds a dynamic `Label` row: `"{symbol} — {bet} x {factor} x {cascade}"`; `HISTORY_BODY_FONT` (13), tan `font_color`, smart autowrap.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_make_side_panel()`, `_make_side_panel_header_strip()`, `_style_side_panel_header()` — panel chrome and **"HISTORY"** header (`SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT` 24).
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_apply_responsive_layout()` — `HistoryPanel` width/height via `LAYOUT_SIDE_*` and `side_panel_h`.
- **`combat_root.gd`** — `line_win_resolved` → `_line_win_event_from_line()`; **`combat_test.gd`** `_on_line_win_resolved()` appends rows.

---

### Execute button positioning

- **`combat_test.tscn`** — `%SpinButton` (`SpinButton`): text **"EXECUTE"**, `custom_minimum_size.y` 72, font 60, `StyleBoxFlat_spin_*` substyles.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_build_play_shell()`: reparents `spin_btn` into runtime `CenterFooter` (below `WinningsCenter`, above `BottomWindowMargin`). `EXECUTE_BUTTON_MIN_HEIGHT`, `CENTER_FOOTER_SEPARATION`.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_layout_execute_button_width()` — width = `combat.grid_ui.size.x`, min height 72; `_layout_combat()` calls it after `fit_to_panel()`.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_configure_spin_button_layer()` — `z_index` 30; `_refresh_spin_button_state()` — **"SPIN LOCKED"** when disabled.

---

### Encounter label (typography / alignment)

**Top-right goal (encounter progress):**

- **`combat_test.tscn`** — `GoalBox` / `%GoalLabel`: default `horizontal_alignment` / `vertical_alignment` = center; text `"GOAL\n0 / 0"`.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_organize_top_hud()` reparents `GoalBox` to root; `_configure_top_corner_hud()` → `GOAL_LABEL_FONT` (26); `_apply_responsive_layout()` → `_place_control_rect(goal_box, LAYOUT_GOAL_BOX_START…LAYOUT_GOAL_BOX_END, LAYOUT_CORNER_Y0…Y1)` (~86–99.2% width, top band).
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_refresh_readouts()` / `_goal_progress_only()` — display `"GOAL\n{current}/{target}"` from `combat.get_goal_label()`.
- **`combat_root.gd`** — `get_chip_bar_goal_label()` — source string `"GOAL: WIN 10x CHIP-BAR  (%d / %d)"`.

**Fullscreen encounter win:**

- **`combat_test.tscn`** — `EncounterWinOverlay` → `EncounterWinPanel` → `%EncounterWinLabel`: font 88, outline 5, centered fill anchors.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_refresh_encounter_win_overlay()` toggles overlay and sets **"Encounter won!"**
- **`combat_root.tscn`** — `EncounterWonLabel` (legacy banner); win UI defers to CombatTest overlay per `_show_encounter_won_banner()`.

---

### Stake indicator placement

- **`combat_test.tscn`** — `StakeSelector` → `BetRow` → `%BetMinusButton`, `%BetLabel`, `%BetPlusButton` (HBox, separation 12, centered).
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_integrate_economics_into_center_hud()`: `EconomicsCenter` → `EconomicsStack` holds `%BankrollLabel` then `StakeSelector`; `_place_control_rect(_economics_center, LAYOUT_CENTER_HUD_START…END, LAYOUT_CENTER_HUD_Y0…Y1)` (~36–64% width, top-center band).
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_style_stake_pill()` wraps `%BetLabel` in runtime `StakePill` (rounded border panel); `_apply_economics_typography()` — stake font 22/18 by viewport width.
- **`combat_test.gd`** — `_refresh_readouts()` — `bet_label.text = "%d"` from `combat.get_current_bet()`; bet buttons call `combat.step_bet()`.

---

### Shared layout / grid sizing (affects all of the above)

- **`combat_test.gd`** — `PlayArea` → `PlayRow` → `HistoryPanel` | `CenterColumn` (`GridHost` + `WinningsCenter` + `CenterFooter`); `_apply_responsive_layout()`, `_place_control_rect()`, `_layout_combat()`, `_layout_premium_bar()`.
- **`combat_root.gd`** — `fit_to_panel()`, `GridUI` position/size, `_layout_grid_fx_nodes()` — grid centering inside `GridHost` drives execute width and symbol slot positions.
